name: MAX30105 particle / heart-rate sensor
description: Maxim MAX30105 optical module with red, infrared and green LEDs, a photodetector and an 18-bit ADC feeding a 32-sample FIFO over I2C (address 0x57). Measures reflected light for smoke/particle detection, presence sensing and fingertip heart rate (PPG), plus a die temperature sensor. Sold as: SparkFun Particle Sensor Breakout - MAX30105 (SEN-14045), 5-pin header SCL, SDA, 5V, GND, INT; on-board 1.8 V regulator, I2C level shifters and 4.7 kOhm pull-ups to the 5V pin.
eli5: Shines red, infrared and green light and measures how much bounces back, so it can see smoke in the air or the tiny colour change in your fingertip each time your heart beats.

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock, level-shifted; 4.7 kOhm pull-up to the 5V pin on the board (PU jumper)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data, level-shifted; 4.7 kOhm pull-up to the 5V pin on the board (PU jumper)

pins.name: 5V
pins.description: Supply for the LEDs and the on-board 1.8 V regulator, 3.3-5 V. The I2C/INT pull-ups go to this pin, so it sets the logic level: feed it 3.3 V from an ESP32/Pico

pins.name: INT
pins.description: Interrupt output, active low (open-drain, 4.7 kOhm pull-up to the 5V pin via the INT jumper); not needed for basic use

supplierQuery: SparkFun MAX30105 particle sensor breakout SEN-14045
buildNotes: Power the 5V pin from 3V3 when using an ESP32 or Pico: the board's SDA/SCL/INT pull-ups go to that pin, so feeding it 5 V would put 5 V on the microcontroller's I2C pins. Red and IR are guaranteed at 3.3 V (VLED+ 3.1-5.25 V); the green LED may be dim below about 3.5 V.
Part ID register 0xFF reads 0x15. Soft reset: write 0x40 to MODE_CONFIG (0x09) and wait for the bit to clear.

Clear FIFO_WR_PTR (0x04), OVF_COUNTER (0x05) and FIFO_RD_PTR (0x06) before starting; unread samples = (WR - RD) & 0x1F. Burst-read FIFO_DATA (0x07): 3 bytes per active LED per sample, 18-bit left-justified.
Multi-LED mode (MODE 0b111) samples the LEDs set in SLOT1-SLOT4 (0x11/0x12) in slot order; the driver uses slot 1 = red, 2 = IR, 3 = green.
LED current 0x00-0xFF = 0-50 mA per LED. Readings near 262143 mean the ADC is saturated: lower the LED current or raise ADC_RGE.
Die temperature: set TEMP_EN (0x21 bit 0), wait about 29 ms, then T = TINT (0x1F, two's complement) + TFRAC (0x20) x 0.0625 C.
Cut the PU jumper if another board on the bus already has pull-ups; the INT jumper removes the INT pull-up.

driver.code:
# MAX30105 particle / heart-rate sensor (Maxim MAX30105), MicroPython driver.
# Register map, FIFO handling and die-temperature readout follow the Maxim MAX30105 datasheet (Rev 1):
# 32-sample FIFO of 3-byte, left-justified 18-bit values per active LED, read by burst-reading FIFO_DATA (0x07).
import time

_INT_STAT1 = 0x00
_INT_STAT2 = 0x01
_FIFO_WR_PTR = 0x04
_OVF_COUNTER = 0x05
_FIFO_RD_PTR = 0x06
_FIFO_DATA = 0x07
_FIFO_CONFIG = 0x08
_MODE_CONFIG = 0x09
_SPO2_CONFIG = 0x0A  # "particle-sensing configuration"
_LED1_PA = 0x0C  # red
_LED2_PA = 0x0D  # IR
_LED3_PA = 0x0E  # green
_PILOT_PA = 0x10
_SLOT12 = 0x11
_SLOT34 = 0x12
_TINT = 0x1F
_TFRAC = 0x20
_TEMP_CONFIG = 0x21
_REV_ID = 0xFE
_PART_ID = 0xFF

PART_ID = 0x15

_RATES = (50, 100, 200, 400, 800, 1000, 1600, 3200)
_PULSE_WIDTHS = (69, 118, 215, 411)  # us -> 15, 16, 17, 18-bit ADC
_ADC_RANGES = (2048, 4096, 8192, 16384)  # nA full scale
_AVERAGES = (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32)

# MODE[2:0]: 0b010 red only, 0b011 red + IR, 0b111 multi-LED (slots below)
MODE_RED = 0x02
MODE_RED_IR = 0x03
MODE_MULTI = 0x07


class MAX30105:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x57):
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        pid = self._r8(_PART_ID)
        if pid != PART_ID:
            raise OSError('MAX30105 not found (part id 0x%02x, expected 0x15): check the wiring' % pid)
        self.channels = 0

    def _r8(self, reg):
        return self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, reg, 1)[0]

    def _w8(self, reg, val):
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, reg, bytes([val & 0xFF]))

    def revision(self):
        return self._r8(_REV_ID)

    def reset(self):
        """Soft reset (MODE_CONFIG bit 6); the bit clears itself when the reset is done."""
        self._w8(_MODE_CONFIG, 0x40)
        t0 = time.ticks_ms()
        while self._r8(_MODE_CONFIG) & 0x40:
            if time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), t0) > 100:
                raise OSError('MAX30105 reset did not finish')
            time.sleep_ms(1)
        self.channels = 0

    def setup(self, leds=3, led_current=0x1F, sample_rate=100, pulse_width=411, adc_range=4096, average=4):
        """Configure and start sampling.
        leds: 1 = red only, 2 = red + IR, 3 = red + IR + green (multi-LED, slots 1-3 = red, IR, green).
        led_current: LEDx_PA code, 0x00-0xFF = 0-50 mA (0x1F = 6.4 mA).
        sample_rate (sps), pulse_width (us: 69/118/215/411 -> 15-18 bit), adc_range (nA), average (samples)."""
        self.reset()
        avg = _AVERAGES.index(average)
        # SMP_AVE[7:5], FIFO_ROLLOVER_EN (bit 4) so the FIFO keeps the newest samples, FIFO_A_FULL = 0x0F (17 samples)
        self._w8(_FIFO_CONFIG, (avg << 5) | 0x10 | 0x0F)
        cfg = (_ADC_RANGES.index(adc_range) << 5) | (_RATES.index(sample_rate) << 2) | _PULSE_WIDTHS.index(pulse_width)
        self._w8(_SPO2_CONFIG, cfg)
        for reg in (_LED1_PA, _LED2_PA, _LED3_PA, _PILOT_PA):
            self._w8(reg, led_current)
        if leds == 3:
            self._w8(_SLOT12, (0x02 << 4) | 0x01)  # SLOT1 = LED1 red, SLOT2 = LED2 IR
            self._w8(_SLOT34, 0x03)  # SLOT3 = LED3 green, SLOT4 off
            mode = MODE_MULTI
        elif leds == 2:
            mode = MODE_RED_IR
        else:
            leds = 1
            mode = MODE_RED
        self.clear_fifo()
        self.channels = leds
        self._w8(_MODE_CONFIG, mode)

    def clear_fifo(self):
        """Datasheet: clear FIFO_WR_PTR, OVF_COUNTER and FIFO_RD_PTR before starting."""
        self._w8(_FIFO_WR_PTR, 0)
        self._w8(_OVF_COUNTER, 0)
        self._w8(_FIFO_RD_PTR, 0)

    def shutdown(self, off=True):
        m = self._r8(_MODE_CONFIG)
        self._w8(_MODE_CONFIG, (m | 0x80) if off else (m & 0x7F))

    def available(self):
        """Unread samples in the FIFO (pointer wrap-around taken into account)."""
        n = (self._r8(_FIFO_WR_PTR) - self._r8(_FIFO_RD_PTR)) & 0x1F
        if n == 0 and self._r8(_OVF_COUNTER):
            n = 32  # full: pointers equal and samples were lost
        return n

    def read_fifo(self):
        """Pop every unread sample: a list of tuples (red[, ir[, green]]) in raw 18-bit ADC counts."""
        if not self.channels:
            raise OSError('call setup() first')
        n = self.available()
        out = []
        if not n:
            return out
        per = 3 * self.channels
        d = self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, _FIFO_DATA, n * per)
        for i in range(n):
            s = []
            for c in range(self.channels):
                o = i * per + 3 * c
                s.append(((d[o] << 16) | (d[o + 1] << 8) | d[o + 2]) & 0x3FFFF)
            out.append(tuple(s))
        return out

    def read(self, timeout_ms=1000):
        """Wait for data and return the newest sample (red[, ir[, green]])."""
        t0 = time.ticks_ms()
        while True:
            s = self.read_fifo()
            if s:
                return s[-1]
            if time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), t0) > timeout_ms:
                raise OSError('MAX30105: no samples (is it set up and powered?)')
            time.sleep_ms(5)

    def temperature(self):
        """Die temperature in degC: TINT (two's complement) + TFRAC x 0.0625 (conversion about 29 ms)."""
        self._w8(_TEMP_CONFIG, 0x01)  # TEMP_EN, self-clearing
        t0 = time.ticks_ms()
        while self._r8(_TEMP_CONFIG) & 0x01 and not (self._r8(_INT_STAT2) & 0x02):
            if time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), t0) > 100:
                break
            time.sleep_ms(2)
        ti = self._r8(_TINT)
        if ti > 127:
            ti -= 256
        tf = self._r8(_TFRAC) & 0x0F  # reading TFRAC clears DIE_TEMP_RDY
        return ti + tf * 0.0625

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from max30105 import MAX30105

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}), freq=400000)
sensor = MAX30105(i2c)
sensor.setup(leds=3, led_current=0x1F, sample_rate=100, pulse_width=411, adc_range=4096, average=1)
while True:
    time.sleep_ms(500)
    red, ir, green = sensor.read()
    t = sensor.temperature()
    print('R=%d IR=%d G=%d T=%.2fC' % (red, ir, green, t))
